title: Raku Night at Ceramica Arthouse
source_quote: RAKU NIGHT "WHERE THERE'S SMOKE, THERE IS FIRE" OCTOBER 30 Jerry will be firing raku pottery in the Vista Village parking lot in front of Ceramica Arthouse from 6-9.
evidence_sentence: The Raku Night event page states Jerry will fire raku pottery on October 30 from 6-9 pm at the Vista Village parking lot.
evidence_quote: Jerry will be firing raku pottery in the Vista Village parking lot in front of Ceramica Arthouse from 6-9.
summary: Public raku firing event on October 30, 2026, 6-9 pm. Bring your own bisque or pottery, or purchase pieces from the studio to fire. $10 at the door plus the cost of the piece; $20 for the Abomination special event firing.
bring: Bisque ware or pottery you've made; or purchase pieces at the studio
cost_text: $10 at the door + tax + the cost of the piece you select for firing OR $10 at the door + tax + $10 per pot you bring yourself
how_to_join: Call ahead to reserve seating: 208-342-3822 or email ceramicaboise@gmail.com
pay_text: $10 at door plus piece cost or $10 per pot brought
